description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to managing remote bundle information, bundle lists, and bundle URI operations in a software project.

methods.name: clear_bundle_list
methods.description: Clears and resets a bundle_list structure.

methods.name: for_all_bundles_in_list
methods.description: Iterates over all bundles in a bundle list, applying a callback function.

methods.name: print_bundle_list
methods.description: Prints the bundle list to a file stream.

methods.name: bundle_uri_parse_config_format
methods.description: Parses a bundle URI in config file format.

methods.name: fetch_bundle_uri
methods.description: Fetches and unbundles data from a given URI, indicating if heuristic info is present.

methods.name: fetch_bundle_list
methods.description: Fetches and unbundles bundles based on a bundle list.

methods.name: bundle_uri_advertise
methods.description: Advertises a bundle URI via a repository.

methods.name: bundle_uri_command
methods.description: Handles bundle URI commands via a repository and packet request.

methods.name: bundle_uri_parse_line
methods.description: Parses a key=value line from a bundle URI.
